notes.subject: evening to morning
notes.rationale: Terror timed at evening, gone before morning — a single night counted off.

notes.subject: שוסינו/לבזזינו
notes.rationale: Parallel near-synonyms for plundering in the two halves of the closing couplet.

notes.subject: balut
notes.rationale: גורל is literally a pebble used for casting lots; 'balut' keeps the allotted-portion sense, not the stone.

notes.subject: לבזזינו
notes.rationale: The 'us' draws the hearer into the community plundered — direct communal address.

translation: Long taim bilong apinun — luk, tranbel i kamap; pastaim yet long moning em i no stap moa. Em i hap bilong ol man i stilim olgeta bilong yumi, na balut bilong ol man i grabim olgeta bilong yumi.
